name: Four Seasons Resort Koh Samui
positioning: Pool-villa resort at the northwestern tip of Koh Samui, Thailand, with a main pool by the white-sand beach
best_for: Travelers who want a private pool villa
Families, with the complimentary Kids For All Seasons program

facts.text: The resort is at 219 Moo 5, Angthong, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84140, Thailand.
The resort is at the northwestern tip of Koh Samui.
The design is based on traditional southern Thai architecture.
The architect is Bensley Design Studios.
The fitness facilities are available 24 hours a day.
KOH Thai Kitchen serves regional Thai cuisine.

highlights.text: The Beach Villa with Pool is a private luxury beachfront pool villa.
The main pool is located by the white-sand beach.
CoCoRum is home to Asia's only rum vault.
The resort has an open-air, professional-grade boxing ring for Muay Thai.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary.

considerations.text: The island's main attractions, including historic temples, are a half-hour drive from the resort.
WhataHotel notes that the remote location requires transfer planning.
WhataHotel notes that premium pricing reflects the ultra-luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
